Cookie.__comment: httpOnly session cookie for the browser merchant portal. SameSite=Lax suits dev + a same-registrable-domain UI/API; set to None (forces Secure) for a cross-site split. Secure omitted => defaults false in Development, true otherwise.
Cookie.Name: cpe_portal_session

Cors.__comment: Browser origins allowed to call this API with credentials (the session cookie). Empty => same-origin only. MUST be exact origins (scheme+host+port), never '*'. Set per deployment to the merchant portal UI origin.

Blockchain.__comment: Canonical asset catalog — the same AssetId identity every host shares (§ ConfigurationAssetCatalog). MUST match the other hosts exactly.

Withdrawal.__comment: The portal submits payout/cash-out REQUESTS, so it needs the same per-chain policy the money host reads (limits + approval threshold). It registers no workers, so it never processes, signs, or broadcasts them (§4.7). MUST match the money host's values or a request accepted here would be judged differently there.
